statement: Source dated 2025 reports: The CCDR estimates that 41% of Libreville's built-up area lay in flood-exposed zones in 2021; unplanned settlement and mangrove loss add to urban and coastal risk.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025 reports: The CCDR estimates that 41% of Libreville's built-up area lay in flood-exposed zones in 2021; unplanned settlement and mangrove loss add to urban and coastal risk.
uncertainty: Built-up-area exposure is not a household share or current risk rate.

statement: Source dated 2025 reports: The CCDR says poor urban households often occupy flood-prone, weakly planned areas and lack resources to adapt; Gabonese urban populations may face heat 7–8°C above rural areas.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025 reports: The CCDR says poor urban households often occupy flood-prone, weakly planned areas and lack resources to adapt; Gabonese urban populations may face heat 7–8°C above rural areas.
uncertainty: The report cites a possible urban–rural heat contrast, not a uniform measured current temperature difference across all Gabonese cities.

statement: Source dated 2025 reports: The CCDR says rural women and girls may walk farther for water and fuel during droughts and disasters, losing time and facing greater harassment and assault risks.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025 reports: The CCDR says rural women and girls may walk farther for water and fuel during droughts and disasters, losing time and facing greater harassment and assault risks.
scenario: The CCDR does not specify a climate scenario for this risk pathway.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF pp. 54–55 (printed 54–55), gender and protection risks

uncertainty: Source-stated conditional mechanism, not a measured climate-attributable assault rate or present incident map.

statement: Source dated 2025-11 reports: The 2025 NDC identifies sea-level rise and erosion threats to Libreville and Port-Gentil, including port and oil infrastructure, and lists gradual relocation of exposed areas among planned measures.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-11 reports: The 2025 NDC identifies sea-level rise and erosion threats to Libreville and Port-Gentil, including port and oil infrastructure, and lists gradual relocation of exposed areas among planned measures.
scenario: The NDC does not specify a climate scenario for these named-place risks.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF pp. 20 and 42 (printed 6 and 28), coastal risk/adaptation

uncertainty: This records a stated risk and planned measure, not an approved relocation timetable.

statement: Source dated 2025-11 reports: The NDC says growing climate-related pressure on farmland, forests and fishing areas may heighten tensions between communities, weaken social cohesion and make climate-linked displacement more harmful.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-11 reports: The NDC says growing climate-related pressure on farmland, forests and fishing areas may heighten tensions between communities, weaken social cohesion and make climate-linked displacement more harmful.
scenario: The NDC does not specify a climate scenario for these conditional risks.

source_refs.locator: One-based PDF p. 46 (printed 32), Paix et sécurité

uncertainty: National NDC risk framing; the separate Congo Basin cross-border discussion does not locate observed community conflict. No emissions scenario or incident estimate.

statement: Source dated 2025-12-04 reports: NAP-II consultations were planned in Libreville, Lambaréné, Mouila, Tchibanga, Mayumba, Port-Gentil, Omboué and Cocobeach; UNDP identifies Cocobeach as especially exposed to erosion and sea-level rise.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-12-04 reports: NAP-II consultations were planned in Libreville, Lambaréné, Mouila, Tchibanga, Mayumba, Port-Gentil, Omboué and Cocobeach; UNDP identifies Cocobeach as especially exposed to erosion and sea-level rise.
institutions: Ministry of Environment, Ecology and Climate
uncertainty: December 2025 planned consultation geography, not a vulnerability ranking of every listed town or proof all meetings occurred. Cocobeach exposure is separately identified by the announcement.

statement: Source dated 2025-12-04 reports: Government and UNDP described a participatory process to collect information from local authorities, businesses, civil society and residents for a national adaptation roadmap.
compact_statement: Source dated 2025-12-04 reports: Government and UNDP described a participatory process to collect information from local authorities, businesses, civil society and residents for a national adaptation roadmap.
uncertainty: Consultation and roadmap preparation do not demonstrate delivery or effectiveness.

statement: Source dated not stated reports: CDC and the national parks agency co-manage a coastal adaptation project using Libreville and Port-Gentil as pilot cities to prioritize investments and upgrade weather stations.
compact_statement: Source dated not stated reports: CDC and the national parks agency co-manage a coastal adaptation project using Libreville and Port-Gentil as pilot cities to prioritize investments and upgrade weather stations.
